parsed.explanation: DC retains local protections and no trans-presentation offence, with functioning courts and national hate-crime/employment protections, but as the federal district it is governed directly by the hostile parent regime. A congressionally imposed facilities ban applies in federal buildings—pervasive in DC—and cannot be repealed locally; federal visa guidance directs refusal where documents cast doubt on sex and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility. Federal custody/immigration practices document hormone denial, conversion measures and sexual abuse. Courts have enjoined some orders, yet the passport restriction was allowed to take effect. Multiple tier-1 institutional exposures without a local remedy place it in elevated risk, mitigated by DC's relative protectiveness.
